style: Photorealistic travel photograph, shot on a full-frame mirrorless camera, natural true-to-life colors, realistic soft light, high detail, vertical composition. No people, no text, no letters, no logos, no signs with writing

items.name: 01-bridge
items.prompt: Night in a Kyoto shrine maple grove: a small vermilion-lacquered arched wooden bridge crossing a narrow stream in a deep valley, hundreds of illuminated red and orange maple trees all around, soft warm lights, dark blue sky

items.name: 01-bridge-b
items.prompt: Vermilion arched footbridge over a small creek at night, surrounded by glowing autumn maples in a steep wooded valley, Kyoto

items.name: 02-odoi
items.prompt: A long grassy earthen embankment (an old earth wall mound) covered with tall maple trees at night, a path running along the top, maples lit in red and gold, Kyoto

items.name: 02-odoi-b
items.prompt: Walking path on top of a tree-covered earth embankment at night, illuminated red maple canopy, old Kyoto

items.name: 03-mitsumata
items.prompt: A single ancient gnarled maple tree with a massive trunk splitting into three thick trunks, 400 years old, illuminated at night, red leaves overhead, mossy ground

items.name: 03-mitsumata-b
items.prompt: Huge old three-trunked Japanese maple tree lit from below at night, crimson leaves, quiet grove

items.name: 04-river
items.prompt: A shallow narrow stream at the bottom of a valley at night, the dark water reflecting illuminated red and yellow maples above, fallen leaves on the stones

items.name: 04-river-b
items.prompt: Night reflections of glowing autumn maples in a calm small river, mirror-like water, Kyoto

items.name: 05-teahouse

items.name: 05-teahouse-b
items.prompt: Wooden viewing deck of a Japanese tea house above a sea of lit red maple trees at night

items.name: 06-honden
items.prompt: View at night from a hillside over the curved cypress-bark roofs of a large old Shinto shrine main hall, softly lit, framed by red maple branches in the foreground

items.name: 06-honden-b
items.prompt: Old Shinto shrine roofs seen through illuminated autumn maples at night, Kyoto
